description: Out of scope request: caller requesting home dispatch of ICU ambulance and surgical team.
turns: Hume ghar par ek portable ICU ambulance aur surgery setup chahiye turant.
Kya Sunrise clinic Dehradun ghar par surgery team bhej sakta hai?
Aap please abhi dispatch team ko bolo nikalne ke liye.

expected.notes: Home ICU dispatch and mobile surgery are outside a general clinic front desk's scope. Naive agents either hallucinate non-existent emergency services or fail to escalate properly.
